                       /etc/boot/rc.* symbolicly links to some program in /sbin likely all the same program but you can change the links to other "boot systems" which are just a single file.
                       The program reads some structured data relating to dependencies ecoded in either some directory structure or in some config files in lsb format or in json.
                       It then executes all the required init scripts in either asynchronous or non-asynchronous fashion in the correct order according to lsb or anything else.

We are ultimately talking about a single executable being able launch programs as defined by etc. That easily can be done in a single file and I think it should, and be as easy to swap as a symbolic link. This is something that can be coded in node, bash, c.
